chapters.title: The Creation of Heaven and Earth
chapters.synopsis: God creates the heavens, the earth, light, seas, plants, and living creatures over six days. Each stage of creation is pronounced good. On the sixth day God creates man and woman in His own image and gives them dominion over the earth.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Moses recounts the six creative periods

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: God creates man and grants dominion

chapters.title: Eden and the First Marriage
chapters.synopsis: God rests on the seventh day and hallows it. He plants the garden of Eden, places Adam there, and commands him not to eat of the tree of knowledge of good and evil. Seeing that it is not good for man to be alone, God creates Eve, and the two are joined as husband and wife.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The sabbath; Adam placed in Eden

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Command concerning the forbidden tree

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Eve created; the first marriage

chapters.title: The Fall of Adam and Eve
chapters.synopsis: The serpent persuades Eve to eat the forbidden fruit, and Adam eats also. Their eyes are opened, and they hide from God, who questions them and pronounces consequences on the serpent, the woman, and the man. Adam and Eve are sent out of Eden into the mortal world.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The serpent beguiles Eve

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: God questions and judges Adam and Eve

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Adam and Eve leave Eden

chapters.title: Cain, Abel, and the First Murder
chapters.synopsis: Cain and Abel bring offerings to the Lord, and Abel's is accepted while Cain's is not. In anger Cain kills his brother and is cursed to wander the earth. The chapter closes with Cain's posterity and the birth of Seth, through whom men begin to call upon the Lord.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Cain slays Abel; Seth is born

chapters.title: The Generations from Adam to Noah
chapters.synopsis: Moses records the family line from Adam through Seth down to Noah, noting the long lives of the patriarchs. Enoch stands out because he walks with God and is taken without tasting death. The genealogy ends with Noah and his three sons.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Genealogy from Adam to Noah

chapters.title: Noah Commanded to Build the Ark
chapters.synopsis: Wickedness fills the earth until God grieves that He made man, but Noah finds grace in His eyes. God tells Noah He will destroy all flesh with a flood and gives him exact instructions for building an ark. Noah obeys everything the Lord commands.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The earth is corrupt before God

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: God commands Noah to build the ark

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Noah does all God commands

chapters.title: The Flood Covers the Earth
chapters.synopsis: The Lord commands Noah to enter the ark with his family and the animals. Rain falls for forty days and the waters rise until every high hill is covered. All flesh outside the ark dies, while Noah and those with him are preserved.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Come thou into the ark

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The flood destroys all flesh

chapters.title: The Waters Recede from the Earth
chapters.synopsis: God remembers Noah, the rains stop, and the ark rests on the mountains of Ararat. Noah sends out a raven and a dove to test whether the ground is dry. At God's word Noah leaves the ark and offers sacrifice, and the Lord promises never again to smite every living thing.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The waters abate; the dove returns

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Go forth from the ark

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Noah's sacrifice; the Lord's promise

chapters.title: The Covenant of the Rainbow
chapters.synopsis: God blesses Noah and his sons, commands them to multiply, and establishes a covenant never again to destroy the earth by flood, setting the rainbow as its token. Noah later plants a vineyard, and an incident with his sons brings a blessing on Shem and Japheth. Noah dies at nine hundred fifty years.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The rainbow covenant established

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Noah's sons; his final years

chapters.title: The Table of Nations
chapters.synopsis: Moses lists the descendants of Shem, Ham, and Japheth after the flood. From these families the nations of the earth spread out into their lands and languages. The record traces how the world was divided among Noah's posterity.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Nations descend from Noah's sons

chapters.title: Babel and the Line to Abram
chapters.synopsis: The people, still of one language, build a tower at Babel to make themselves a name, and the Lord confounds their speech and scatters them abroad. Moses then traces the family line from Shem down to Terah. Terah's son Abram marries Sarai, and the family journeys toward Canaan as far as Haran.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The tower of Babel; genealogy to Abram

chapters.title: The Call and Covenant of Abram
chapters.synopsis: The Lord calls Abram to leave his country, promising to make of him a great nation in whom all families of the earth will be blessed. Abram journeys through Canaan, building altars near Bethel. A famine drives him to Egypt, where Pharaoh takes Sarai until God intervenes with plagues.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Get thee out; the great promise

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abram in Canaan and Egypt

chapters.title: Abram and Lot Part Ways
chapters.synopsis: Abram returns from Egypt to Bethel, rich in flocks and herds. When strife arises between his herdmen and Lot's, Abram generously lets Lot choose first, and Lot picks the well-watered plain of Jordan near Sodom. The Lord then renews His promise, giving Abram all the land he can see and posterity as the dust of the earth.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abram and Lot separate peacefully

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: All the land promised to Abram's seed

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abram settles at Hebron

chapters.title: Abram Rescues Lot; Melchizedek Blesses
chapters.synopsis: Warring kings sack Sodom and carry Lot away captive. Abram arms his household, defeats the kings by night, and recovers Lot and all the goods. Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of the most high God, blesses Abram, who pays him tithes and refuses any reward from the king of Sodom.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The battle of the kings; Lot rescued

segments.speaker: melchizedek
segments.note: Melchizedek blesses Abram

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abram refuses the spoils of Sodom

chapters.title: The Covenant Sealed in Vision
chapters.synopsis: In vision the Lord promises childless Abram an heir from his own body and posterity as numberless as the stars, and Abram's belief is counted to him for righteousness. Through a solemn sacrifice the Lord covenants to give the land to Abram's seed. He also foretells four hundred years of affliction in a strange land before their return.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord covenants with Abram in vision

chapters.title: Hagar and the Birth of Ishmael
chapters.synopsis: Sarai, still barren, gives her handmaid Hagar to Abram, but once Hagar conceives, contention drives her into the wilderness. The angel of the Lord finds her by a fountain, tells her to return, and promises that her son Ishmael will father a multitude. Hagar returns and bears Ishmael when Abram is eighty-six.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Hagar conceives and flees from Sarai

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The angel promises Ishmael's posterity

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Ishmael is born to Abram

chapters.title: The Covenant of Circumcision
chapters.synopsis: When Abram is ninety-nine, the Lord appears and establishes an everlasting covenant, changing his name to Abraham and Sarai's to Sarah. Circumcision is given as the covenant's token, and God promises that Sarah herself will bear Isaac within a year. Abraham circumcises every male of his house that same day.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Names changed; circumcision; Isaac promised

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abraham obeys the same day

chapters.title: Three Visitors and a Promised Son
chapters.synopsis: Three holy visitors come to Abraham's tent at Mamre, and he feeds them. The Lord promises that Sarah will bear a son within the year, and Sarah laughs within herself, for she is old. As the visitors turn toward Sodom, the Lord reveals its coming judgment, and Abraham boldly pleads for the city to be spared for the sake of the righteous.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abraham entertains three visitors

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Sarah shall bear; Sodom's doom weighed

segments.speaker: abraham
segments.note: Abraham pleads for Sodom

chapters.title: The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah
chapters.synopsis: Two angels come to Sodom, and Lot shelters them from the violent men of the city. At dawn the angels pull Lot's family out of the city, and the Lord rains fire and brimstone on Sodom and Gomorrah. Lot's wife looks back and becomes a pillar of salt, while Lot and his daughters escape to the mountains.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Angels rescue Lot; Sodom destroyed

chapters.title: Abraham and Abimelech at Gerar
chapters.synopsis: Abraham sojourns in Gerar and again calls Sarah his sister, so Abimelech the king takes her. God warns Abimelech in a dream that Sarah is a married woman, and he restores her with gifts and an honest rebuke. Abraham prays for Abimelech's house, and God heals them.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: God warns Abimelech; Sarah restored

chapters.title: Isaac Born; Hagar Sent Away
chapters.synopsis: Sarah bears Isaac in Abraham's old age, just as the Lord promised. At Sarah's insistence Hagar and Ishmael are sent into the wilderness, where God hears the lad's voice and preserves them, promising Ishmael a great nation. Abraham and Abimelech make a covenant of peace at Beersheba.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Isaac is born; Sarah's demand

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Hearken unto Sarah; Ishmael blessed

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Hagar despairs in the wilderness

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: God hears the lad's voice

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Ishmael preserved; covenant at Beersheba

chapters.title: The Offering of Isaac
chapters.synopsis: God tests Abraham, commanding him to offer his beloved son Isaac on mount Moriah. Abraham obeys, and at the last moment the angel of the Lord stays his hand and a ram is provided instead. Because Abraham withheld nothing, the Lord swears that in his seed all nations of the earth will be blessed.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Take now thy son, thine only son

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abraham and Isaac ascend Moriah

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The sacrifice stayed; the oath sworn

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The return; Nahor's family

chapters.title: Sarah's Death and Burial at Machpelah
chapters.synopsis: Sarah dies at Hebron at one hundred twenty-seven years, and Abraham mourns for her. He courteously negotiates with the sons of Heth and buys the cave of Machpelah from Ephron for four hundred shekels of silver. It becomes the family burying place, Abraham's first owned ground in the promised land.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abraham buys the cave of Machpelah

chapters.title: A Wife Sought for Isaac
chapters.synopsis: Abraham sends his trusted servant back to his kindred to find a wife for Isaac. At a well the servant prays for a sign, and Rebekah answers it exactly, drawing water for him and his camels. Her family consents, Rebekah willingly goes, and Isaac loves her and is comforted after his mother's death.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abraham charges his servant with an oath

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The prayer at the well; Rebekah found

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Rebekah consents and marries Isaac

chapters.title: Esau and Jacob: The Birthright Sold
chapters.synopsis: Abraham dies at one hundred seventy-five and is buried beside Sarah at Machpelah. Rebekah, barren for years, conceives twins, and the Lord tells her that two nations struggle in her womb and the elder will serve the younger. Esau, a hunter, sells his birthright to Jacob for a mess of pottage.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Abraham's death; Rebekah conceives twins

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Two nations are in thy womb

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Esau sells his birthright to Jacob

chapters.title: Isaac's Covenant and Wells
chapters.synopsis: During a famine the Lord tells Isaac to stay in Gerar and renews with him the covenant made with Abraham. Isaac prospers greatly, and the envious Philistines stop up his wells until he moves and digs again, finding room at Rehoboth. At Beersheba the Lord appears again, and Abimelech comes to make a covenant of peace with him.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Famine sends Isaac toward Gerar

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Abrahamic covenant renewed with Isaac

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Isaac prospers; strife over the wells

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Fear not, for I am with thee

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Covenant with Abimelech at Beersheba

chapters.title: Jacob Obtains the Blessing
chapters.synopsis: Aged and dim-eyed, Isaac prepares to bless Esau, but Rebekah disguises Jacob in his brother's clothing. Isaac unknowingly gives Jacob the blessing of the firstborn, with dew of heaven and dominion over his brethren. When the deception is discovered, Esau weeps and vows to kill Jacob, and Rebekah arranges to send Jacob away to her brother Laban.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Rebekah's plan; Jacob disguised

segments.speaker: isaac
segments.note: Isaac pronounces the firstborn blessing

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Esau's grief; Jacob must flee

chapters.title: Jacob's Ladder at Bethel
chapters.synopsis: Isaac blesses Jacob again and sends him to Padan-aram to marry among his mother's kindred. On the way Jacob sleeps at Bethel and dreams of a ladder reaching to heaven with angels ascending and descending. The Lord stands above it and renews the covenant of Abraham with him, and Jacob vows that the Lord shall be his God.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob sent away; the ladder dream

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The covenant renewed at Bethel

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob's vow; the pillar at Bethel

chapters.title: Jacob Serves for Rachel and Leah
chapters.synopsis: Jacob arrives in Haran, meets Rachel at the well, and agrees to serve her father Laban seven years for her hand. On the wedding night Laban substitutes Leah, and Jacob must serve seven more years for Rachel. Leah, less loved, bears Jacob four sons, including Levi and Judah.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob deceived; Leah bears four sons

chapters.title: The Children of Jacob Multiply
chapters.synopsis: Rivalry between Rachel and Leah brings Jacob many children through them and their handmaids, and at last God remembers Rachel and she bears Joseph. Jacob then seeks to return home, but Laban persuades him to stay for wages of speckled and spotted flocks. Through skill and God's blessing Jacob's flocks increase greatly.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Eleven sons born; Jacob's flocks increase

chapters.title: Jacob Flees from Laban
chapters.synopsis: The Lord tells Jacob to return to the land of his fathers, and he recounts to Rachel and Leah how God has protected him despite Laban's changing wages. Jacob departs secretly with his family and flocks, and Laban pursues him to mount Gilead, but God warns Laban in a dream not to harm him. After sharp words the two make a covenant of peace at a heap of witness stones.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Laban's countenance turns against Jacob

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Return unto the land of thy fathers

segments.speaker: jacob-israel
segments.note: Jacob recounts God's dealings with him

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The flight, pursuit, and covenant heap

chapters.title: Wrestling at Peniel; Named Israel
chapters.synopsis: Learning that Esau approaches with four hundred men, Jacob divides his camp and pleads with God to deliver him, then sends generous gifts ahead to his brother. Alone at the ford Jabbok he wrestles with a heavenly visitor until daybreak. His name is changed to Israel, for as a prince he has power with God, and he calls the place Peniel.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Esau approaches; Jacob divides his camp

segments.speaker: jacob-israel
segments.note: Jacob's prayer for deliverance

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Gifts sent ahead to Esau

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob wrestles and is named Israel

chapters.title: Jacob and Esau Reconciled
chapters.synopsis: Jacob bows himself seven times before Esau, but Esau runs to embrace him, and the brothers weep together. Esau at first refuses the gift, then accepts it at Jacob's urging, and offers to travel with him. Jacob journeys gently to Succoth and then to Shechem, where he buys ground and raises an altar to the God of Israel.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The brothers embrace; an altar raised

chapters.title: The Trouble at Shechem
chapters.synopsis: Dinah, Jacob's daughter, is defiled by Shechem the son of Hamor, who then seeks to marry her. Jacob's sons answer deceitfully, requiring every male of the city to be circumcised. While the men are sore, Simeon and Levi slay them all and spoil the city, and Jacob fears the reprisal of the land.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Dinah wronged; Simeon and Levi's revenge

chapters.title: Return to Bethel; Rachel Dies
chapters.synopsis: God commands Jacob to return to Bethel, so his household puts away their strange gods and he builds an altar there. God appears again, confirms the name Israel, and renews the promises of nations and land. On the journey Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin, and Isaac dies at Hebron and is buried by Esau and Jacob.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Arise, go up to Bethel

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Idols buried; the altar at Bethel

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The name Israel and covenant confirmed

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Benjamin born; Rachel and Isaac die

chapters.title: The Generations of Esau
chapters.synopsis: Moses records the family of Esau, who is Edom, and his move to mount Seir away from Jacob because their riches were too great to dwell together. The chapter lists Esau's sons, the dukes of Edom, and the kings who reigned there before any king reigned in Israel.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Genealogy of Esau and the dukes of Edom

chapters.title: Joseph Sold into Egypt
chapters.synopsis: Jacob loves Joseph more than all his sons and gives him a coat of many colours, and Joseph's dreams of sheaves and stars bowing to him deepen his brothers' hatred. At Dothan they strip him, cast him into a pit, and sell him to Ishmaelite traders for twenty pieces of silver. They dip the coat in blood, and Jacob mourns his son as dead while Joseph is sold to Potiphar in Egypt.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The coat of many colours; the brothers' envy

segments.speaker: joseph-egypt
segments.note: Joseph recounts his prophetic dreams

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Joseph sold; Jacob mourns

chapters.title: Judah and Tamar
chapters.synopsis: Judah leaves his brothers, marries a Canaanite, and raises sons who die in wickedness, leaving Tamar a childless widow. When Judah withholds his youngest son from her, Tamar disguises herself and bears twins by Judah himself. Confronted with his own pledge, Judah confesses that she has been more righteous than he.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Judah's sons; Tamar bears Pharez and Zarah

chapters.title: Joseph in Potiphar's House
chapters.synopsis: The Lord is with Joseph in Egypt, and Potiphar makes him overseer of all he has. Potiphar's wife tempts Joseph day after day, but he refuses to sin against God and flees, leaving his garment in her hand. Falsely accused, Joseph is cast into prison, where the Lord again gives him favour with the keeper.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Joseph resists temptation; cast into prison

chapters.title: Dreams of the Butler and Baker
chapters.synopsis: Pharaoh's chief butler and chief baker are imprisoned with Joseph, and each dreams a troubling dream. Joseph, declaring that interpretations belong to God, tells the butler he will be restored in three days and the baker that he will be hanged. Both come to pass, yet the restored butler forgets Joseph.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Joseph interprets two prisoners' dreams

chapters.title: Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dreams
chapters.synopsis: Two years later Pharaoh dreams of seven lean kine devouring seven fat ones, and of thin ears consuming full ears, and none can interpret. The butler remembers Joseph, who is brought from prison and declares that God has shown Pharaoh seven years of plenty followed by seven of famine. Pharaoh sets Joseph over all Egypt, and he gathers corn as the sand of the sea against the famine.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Pharaoh dreams; Joseph brought from prison

segments.speaker: pharaoh
segments.note: Pharaoh recounts his double dream

segments.speaker: joseph-egypt
segments.note: God hath shewed Pharaoh what He will do

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Joseph made ruler; the famine begins

chapters.title: Ten Brothers Bow Before Joseph
chapters.synopsis: The famine drives Jacob's ten elder sons to Egypt to buy corn, and they bow before Joseph without knowing him. Joseph speaks roughly, accuses them as spies, and keeps Simeon bound until they bring Benjamin. Finding their money returned in their sacks, the brothers tremble, and Jacob refuses at first to let Benjamin go.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The brothers buy corn; Simeon held

chapters.title: Benjamin Comes Down to Egypt
chapters.synopsis: When the corn is spent, Judah pledges his own life for Benjamin, and Jacob at last sends his sons back with double money and a present. Joseph brings them to his own house and feasts them, asking tenderly after their father. Seeing Benjamin, he must leave the room to weep, and Benjamin's portion is five times any of theirs.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The brothers return; Joseph feasts them

chapters.title: The Silver Cup and Judah's Plea
chapters.synopsis: Joseph has his silver cup hidden in Benjamin's sack, and his steward overtakes the brothers and accuses them. Brought back in anguish, they are told Benjamin must remain as a servant. Judah steps forward and pleads to stay in the boy's place, for he cannot bear to see his father's grief if Benjamin is lost.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The cup found in Benjamin's sack

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Judah pleads to take Benjamin's place

chapters.title: Joseph Reveals Himself
chapters.synopsis: Unable to refrain any longer, Joseph sends everyone out and weeps aloud, telling his brothers, 'I am Joseph.' He assures them that God, not they, sent him to Egypt to preserve life, and bids them bring their father down to dwell in Goshen. Pharaoh gladly confirms the invitation, and Jacob's spirit revives at the news that Joseph is alive.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Joseph weeps before his brothers

segments.speaker: joseph-egypt
segments.note: God did send me to preserve life

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Pharaoh's welcome; Jacob's spirit revives

chapters.title: Israel Journeys Down to Egypt
chapters.synopsis: Jacob offers sacrifice at Beersheba, and God speaks in the visions of the night, telling him not to fear to go down into Egypt, for there He will make of him a great nation. All Jacob's family, seventy souls, travel into Egypt. Joseph rides to Goshen to meet his father, and they weep on each other's necks.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Sacrifice at Beersheba

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Fear not to go down into Egypt

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Seventy souls; father and son reunited

chapters.title: Jacob Blesses Pharaoh; Goshen Given
chapters.synopsis: Joseph presents his father and brothers to Pharaoh, and aged Jacob blesses the king. The family settles in the best of the land in Goshen, while the famine grows so severe that Joseph gathers all Egypt's money, cattle, and land for Pharaoh. Jacob lives seventeen years in Egypt and makes Joseph swear to bury him with his fathers in Canaan.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Israel settles in Goshen; the famine deepens

chapters.title: Ephraim and Manasseh Blessed
chapters.synopsis: On his deathbed Jacob adopts Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh as his own, giving them each a tribal inheritance in Israel. Guiding his hands wittingly, he crosses them to set the younger Ephraim before Manasseh despite Joseph's protest. He blesses the lads in the name of the God who has fed him all his life long.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob adopts and crosses his hands

segments.speaker: jacob-israel
segments.note: Jacob blesses Ephraim and Manasseh

chapters.title: Jacob Blesses the Twelve Tribes
chapters.synopsis: Jacob gathers his twelve sons to tell them what shall befall them in the last days. He blesses each in turn, promising Judah the sceptre until Shiloh come and pronouncing Joseph a fruitful bough whose branches run over the wall. Having charged them to bury him in the cave of Machpelah, Jacob gathers up his feet and dies.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob calls his sons together

segments.speaker: jacob-israel
segments.note: Jacob blesses the twelve tribes

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: The burial charge; Jacob dies

chapters.title: Burials and a Promise of Deliverance
chapters.synopsis: Joseph mourns his father, and with Pharaoh's leave a great company carries Jacob to Canaan and buries him in the cave of Machpelah. The brothers fear revenge, but Joseph comforts them: they meant evil, but God meant it unto good. Joseph lives to see his great-grandchildren, prophesies that God will bring Israel out of Egypt, and dies at one hundred ten.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: Jacob buried; Joseph forgives and dies
